declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Only font sizes and --line-height partners may live under --text-* in @theme: that namespace emits font-size utilities, so a color declared here silently becomes a font size with no build error. Colors belong under --color-text-*. See docs/design-system.md §4. --text-shadow-* is Tailwind's text-shadow scale, and may only be stripped to initial (§9).

custom-property-pattern.message: Custom properties are kebab-case. The one exception is Tailwind's size partner, --text-<name>--line-height, which every size in @theme must declare (docs/design-system.md §8.1).

declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Only font sizes and their --line-height partners, in rem, may live under --text-* in @theme: that namespace emits font-size utilities, so a colour declared here silently becomes a font size with no build error. Colours belong under --color-text-*. See docs/design-system.md §4 and §7.5.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Font weight above 600: at 13px on a dark canvas, bold weights bloom and reduce legibility rather than increasing emphasis. Use --color-text-primary or --font-semibold, not both plus bold. See docs/design-system.md §8.5.
